label_generation.method: For each replicate, generate a fresh two-label permutation after both outputs exist. The parent keeps the mapping and a random secret salt out of the filesystem during scoring.
label_generation.seal: Before evaluation, write only SHA-256(canonical mapping JSON plus a random secret salt) to label-map.commitment.json. After evaluator scores are hash-sealed, write label-map.revealed.json with the mapping and salt so the run verifier can confirm the prior commitment.
label_generation.anti_pattern: Do not reuse a fixed X=B/Y=C mapping across replicates.

blind_packet.evaluator_context: Fresh worker with no inherited task turns. It may read only the listed files and may not search the worktree.

evaluation_order: Validate both outputs against product truth and transfer veto.
Score each blinded output with blind-quality-rubric.json.
Record a forced pairwise preference plus rationale for each replicate.
Reveal the label map and route receipts.
Apply kyle-fidelity-rubric.json to Arm C as a separate unblinded diagnostic.
Compute medians and the C-minus-B delta.
Apply hard failures before declaring pass or fail.
evaluator_rules: Do not reward a route name, expert identity, or recognizable terminology.
Do not repair an output while scoring it.
Cite exact lines for every deduction and hard failure.
Treat annotations as claims to verify, not proof by themselves.
State ties only in criterion scoring; pairwise preference must choose the more useful opening set.
